name: Quiet Material v0.7

Its own docs/website-redesign/CURRENT-DESIGN-SYSTEM.md calls it canonical; the source folder's README.md still names v0.5. See design/explorations/2026-09-01-quiet-material-v0.7/README.md and design/PROVENANCE.md for how this was found and preserved, and the Codex handoff round 23 candidate for the competing direction reviewed against the same baseline.

scale.note: Full responsive marketing type ladder lives in the preserved source, not restated here — see the exploration README for the file path.

motion.note: Not captured in this token file — see the preserved source's own CSS for stage/atmosphere transition timing.

provenance.note: Values transcribed from the color, spacing, and radius sections of the preserved token file (391 of 669 files of the original dated folder; see that folder's own README.md for the full preservation record and the release tag with the complete byte-for-byte zip). Palette here is the subset actually used as flat colors — the file also defines gradient and image-backed tokens (surface-stage-soft, pattern-folded-*, etc.) that this flat JSON schema does not represent; read the source file directly for those.
